notes.text: Flow funding grew from your conversations with Simon, and he is a member automatically.
This list: every update now says in one line what changed. Updates with nothing to see reload quietly.
Tap a Claude answer (yellow bar, Claude card or lock screen) to read it in full, with Share and Got it.
The yellow bar shows today's wins (tap for the list). Task dots are no longer cut off on the left.
Notices like 'Claude answered' appear in the yellow bar instead of popping up.
From build 19, app updates download and open the installer from inside the app.
Rows fit the phone screen: task ticks and the contact form no longer run off the side.
A One Button key opens every space you are in, with no account code.
Main screen: seed spaces, then conversation spaces with their projects inside, then people. Calls: say 'call' and pick Phone, WhatsApp or Signal.
